title: Aligning two sequences
caption: An alignment lines up two sequences so that matching positions sit in the same column; a mismatch (×) and a gap (–, standing for an insertion or deletion) each cost points. Dynamic programming finds the alignment with the best total score, and percentage identity is the share of identical positions.
alt: Two alignments of GATTACA: against GCTTACA, six matches and one mismatch scoring 5; and against GATACA, six matches and one gap scoring 4.
description: Scoring: +1 for a match, −1 for a mismatch, −2 for a gap.
GATTACA against GCTTACA: six matches and one mismatch, score 5, 86% identical.
GATTACA against GATACA: one T is missing, so a gap is needed; six matches and one gap, score 4.
The best score is found by dynamic programming (Needleman–Wunsch); any other alignment scores less.
